text: {"assertions":["A latency spike was discovered in ml/serving/batcher.py that only occurred when processing empty input lists.","The root cause of the latency spike was a listener that was registered but never removed during teardown.","The fix removed the listener on teardown and added a test assertion to prevent regression.","The fix was submitted as PR #3078 on branch fix/latency-spike-1.","The latency spike was reproduced by sending a mixed-size request trace.","After the fix was deployed, the serving alert remained quiet for 44 consecutive days."]}
